dashboard.description: Dashboard showing "kubectl exec" runs for selected clusters and namespaces, split by Kubernetes workload.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({cluster=~"$cluster", job="$export_job"} |~ "process_exec" |~ "$namespace" |~ "$container_runtime" | json | process_exec_process_pod_namespace =~ "$namespace" and process_exec_parent_binary=`$container_runtime` and process_exec_parent_pid != 1 [$__range])) by (process_exec_process_pod_workload)

panels.description: Monitoring the /usr/bin/bash, /usr/bin/sh, /bin/bash or /bin/sh binary executions in the Kubernetes workloads

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({cluster=~"$cluster", job="$export_job"} |~"process_exec" |~"$namespace" | json | (process_exec_process_pod_namespace=~"$namespace" and (process_exec_parent_binary=`/bin/sh` or process_exec_parent_binary=`/usr/bin/sh` or process_exec_parent_binary=`/bin/bash` or process_exec_parent_binary=`/usr/bin/bash`) or (process_exec_parent_binary=`$container_runtime` and process_exec_parent_pid != 1)) [$__range])) by (process_exec_process_pod_workload)

core_pattern escape stages
panels.description: Two stages of the 02-core-pattern-scenario. overwrite = openat write to /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern; exec = security_bprm_check of the staged handler binary under the containerd overlay upperdir (the moment the attacker's command actually runs as host root).

targets.expr: sum by (stage, namespace, pod) (count_over_time({cluster=~"$cluster", job="$export_job", tag=~"core-pattern"} [$__auto]))
